baslik: A Tanker Fire Melted a Freeway Ramp

sahneler.metin: Before dawn in Oakland, a tanker truck overturned on a freeway ramp.
It burst into flames, and the ramp above collapsed within minutes.
It was carrying eight thousand six hundred gallons of gasoline.
Fuel spilled and burned below the ramp.
The heat weakened the steel structure.
The steel above lost its strength.
A long section of the upper ramp fell.
It showed how quickly fire can defeat steel.
